role: VoiceAudioPipeline extension for the voice-chat capture loop: start cue, AVAudioSession interruption handling, teardown/deactivation with retry, the 0.2 s silence/watchdog timer, turn finalisation (Apple STT or WhisperKit), echo guards, dispatch to AssistantViewModel, and mirroring the streaming assistant turn into TTS.
types: VoiceAudioPipeline: extension — turn handling and streaming observation

flags.text: Mechanical rename left 'controller.' inside comments and a user-visible log string ('tearing down voice as a safety controller.stop', 'the user can controller.speak again'), making logs and docs misleading.

units.does: Fires a light UIImpactFeedbackGenerator haptic and plays system sound 1057 when voice listening starts.

Removes any existing observer, then registers a main-queue NotificationCenter observer for AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification that forwards the interruption type to handleAudioInterruption via controller.audio; stores the token on the controller.
If an interruption observer token exists, removes it from NotificationCenter and nils it.

branches.effect: true: removed and cleared; false: no-op

units.does: On .began cancels the recognition task and ends the request (both nilled); on .ended calls controller.stop() (full teardown, user must re-tap).

branches.cond: typeRaw present and maps to InterruptionType

branches.effect: recognition task/request cancelled; silence timer and state untouched

flags.text: On .began the 0.2 s silence timer keeps running in .listening; if the app keeps executing during the interruption, the 30 s max-turn cap or empty-transcript path calls startFreshRecognitionTask while the session is interrupted.
The .began log says 'will attempt recovery on end' but .ended deliberately tears down instead.

The section comment says on .ended with .shouldResume the code re-activates the session, restarts the engine and opens a fresh recognition request; the handler instead calls controller.stop() unconditionally (shouldResume is never read).

units.does: Invalidates the silence timer, cancels the recognition task/request, stops the engine via ObjC-safe shims, releases the .voice audio-session claim, then requests deactivation through BackgroundAudioManager.deactivateIfIdle.
Removes the input-node tap via FRSafeRemoveTap and, if the engine is running, stops it via FRSafeAudioEngineStop; both shim errors are discarded.

branches.effect: false: return after tap removal; true: engine stopped

flags.text: NSErrors from FRSafeRemoveTap/FRSafeAudioEngineStop are captured into locals and never logged.

units.does: Asks BackgroundAudioManager.deactivateIfIdle to deactivate the session; its completion runs deactivationFinished with the controller and retry flag.
calls: ext:AVAudioSession.setActive(false) (inside BackgroundAudioManager.deactivateIfIdle, skipped when a cue or another claimant holds the session)

units.does: Deactivation completion (on the cue manager's queue): success or already-inactive error → returns (logs if it was the retry); any other error hops to the main actor's handleDeactivationFailure.

branches.cond: no error, or error is kAudioSessionNotActiveError

units.does: True when the NSError is NSOSStatusErrorDomain code 560030580 ('!act', session not active).

First failure: logs and schedules a 0.5 s delayed retry of deactivateAudioSession(isRetry:true); retry failure: logs error and sets controller.permissionError to a 'Microphone is currently held by another app' message.

branches.effect: false: schedule retry; true: user-visible permissionError

units.does: Invalidates any silence timer and schedules a repeating 0.2 s Timer whose tick hops to the main actor and calls silenceTimerTick.
Per 0.2 s tick: in .speaking runs barge-in check; in .listening runs max-turn cap, stalled-recogniser watchdogs, then end-of-turn commit; other states do nothing.
units.entry: Timer scheduled by armSilenceTimer (0.2 s repeating)

units.does: If turnStartedAt is set and maxTurnDurationSec has elapsed, logs and calls finalizeUserTurn, returning true; else false.

branches.effect: true: finalize, return true; false: return false

units.does: With no transcript growth yet this turn and no prior first-partial restart: after firstPartialTimeoutSec with >=2 s voice, restarts recognition once (count++); else after longIdleRestartSec with <0.5 s voice, restarts recognition and resets turnStartedAt.

branches.cond: turn started, no transcript growth, no first-partial restart yet

branches.effect: true: restart, increment counter, return true
false: return false; true: restart and reset clock

flags.text: Long-idle restart is also gated on firstPartialRestartsThisTurn == 0 (line 226), so after one first-partial restart the ~60 s recogniser self-termination guard no longer runs for that turn.

The long-idle restart (line 234, elapsed >= longIdleRestartSec = 45 s) can never run: silenceTimerTick checks hitMaxTurnDuration first, which finalizes at maxTurnDurationSec = 30 s, and the empty-transcript path then resets turnStartedAt. A silent user therefore gets an empty finalize every 30 s, each incrementing consecutiveEmptyReArms (reset only by a non-empty transcript or beginUserTurn), so voice tears itself down after ~3 min ('I'm not picking up what you're saying') with mic buffers, or ~90 s ('Couldn't hear you') without; the 45 s restart described in the comment does not exist in practice.

units.does: Finalizes when VAD saw >= minVoiceForTurnSec voice and silence > endOfTurnSilenceSec, or when the partial transcript has >= stalledTranscriptMinChars and has not grown for stalledTranscriptCommitSec.

branches.cond: enough voice and silence beyond endOfTurnSilenceSec
transcript long enough and stalled beyond stalledTranscriptCommitSec

units.does: Only in .listening: stops the silence timer, then either completes finalisation immediately (Apple STT) or, when WhisperKit is selected for this session and its model is ready, awaits the WhisperKit path in a Task.

branches.effect: false: completeFinalizeUserTurn; true: async WhisperKit transcription

units.does: Awaits WhisperKitSTTBridge.transcribeAndReset; non-empty text replaces partialTranscript; errors are logged and the Apple transcript kept; then, if still listening, completes finalisation.

branches.effect: true: replaces partialTranscript; false: Apple transcript kept
logged as warning; falls back to Apple transcript
false: return (voice closed or turn already sent)

flags.text: The silence timer is invalidated before the await (line 273-274) and state stays .listening during WhisperKit transcription, so nothing else commits but another finalizeUserTurn caller (Control.swift:22 tap, Speech.swift:188) can start a second WhisperKit transcription concurrently; only the post-await state check guards the double send.

units.does: Empty-transcript path: increments consecutiveEmptyReArms; if give-up threshold hit sets permissionError and stops voice; else clears VAD accumulators, resets turn clock, rotates the recognition task when the mic delivered buffers, re-arms the timer and drains pending triggers.

branches.effect: true: fresh recognition task; false: same task kept

units.does: Returns a localized give-up message when the mic is dead (no buffers) for >=3 consecutive empty turns or when the recogniser is confused (buffers present) for >=6; else nil.

branches.effect: 'I'm not picking up...' message; else nil

units.does: Trims partialTranscript; empty → handleEmptyTranscript; otherwise resets the empty counter, drops echoes, else dispatches the transcript.
Drops the transcript as echo when it looks like the last AI reply (flashes a transient inbox notice, re-arms) or when it is a medical-refusal echo (re-arms); returns whether it dropped.

branches.effect: true: warning log, transient notice, reArmListening, return true
false: return false; true: log, reArmListening, return true (no user notice)

units.does: True when MedicalQueryGuard would refuse the transcript, that exact refusal is the last assistant turn's text, and the transcript shares >=40% of tokens with it.

branches.cond: guard returns .refuse(reply) and last assistant text == reply

units.does: Sends the transcript via AssistantViewModel.send(fromVoice:true) and routes the outcome: dispatched → speak instant turn or open the speaking window; queued → handleQueuedSend; rejected → handleRejectedSend; requiresConsent → handleConsentRequired.

branches.effect: instant turn spoken directly, else falls through to beginSpeakingWindow

flags.text: send() returns .dispatched even when AssistantViewModel.dispatch() returns early without starting a stream (routed provider unavailable, Routing.swift:234; routed provider lacks consent, Routing.swift:238). isStreaming stays false and the last turn is the user's (or, after the consent gate removes it, the previous assistant reply — see :458). In the first case spokeInstantTurn returns false, beginSpeakingWindow sets .speaking, and the finishing observer (ObservationLoop default initial:false) never fires because isStreaming never changes, so voice stays in .speaking until the user taps.

units.does: If the view model is not streaming and the last turn is a non-empty assistant turn (canned refusal / deterministic answer), speaks it directly via speakCompletedTurn and returns true.

branches.cond: not streaming and last turn is a non-empty assistant turn

flags.text: The medical guard runs in send() before the isStreaming check, so a refusal is appended and .dispatched returned while another stream is still in flight (voice is .listening during a queued send, handleQueuedSend). spokeInstantTurn then returns false (isStreaming true), beginSpeakingWindow points activeAssistantIndex at the refusal turn, which never gets a speakableTextCursor, so the refusal is never spoken and voice re-arms when the other stream ends.

'Instant turn' is inferred from 'not streaming and last turn is a non-empty assistant turn'. When dispatch() stops at the consent gate it removes the user turn (Routing.swift:380-381), so the last turn is the previous assistant reply and voice speaks that old answer again; the user is not told consent is needed.

units.does: Queued send: clears transcript and VAD accumulators, wires a one-shot observer for the queued turn's stream start, rotates recognition, re-arms the timer and returns to .listening.
rejectedEmpty → re-arm listening; otherwise shows the view model's errorMessage (or 'Voice can't send right now.') as permissionError and re-arms.

branches.effect: fallback 'Voice can't send right now.' when the view model set no error

units.does: Per-provider consent needed: sets a permissionError telling the user to accept the data-sharing notice in the Flo tab, clears transcript/VAD state and stops voice.
Clears transcript and VAD accumulators, starts a fresh recognition task, re-arms the timer, sets .listening and drains pending coach triggers.

Sets up the speaking window for a streamed reply: tracks the last turn index as the assistant turn, resets spoken cursor/response text/chunker, clears ttsStartedAt, zeroes barge-in baselines, rotates recognition (mic stays live for barge-in), re-arms the timer, sets .speaking and starts streaming observation.

Bumps responseSpeakGeneration, snapshots the stream edge, and registers an ObservationLoop on (isStreaming, streamGeneration) that calls beginQueuedTurnSpeaking when the generation still matches and VoiceTurnPolicy.queuedTurnStarted says a new stream began; handle appended to assistantObservers.

branches.cond: generation unchanged and queued turn started

units.does: Returns a StreamEdge of the view model's isStreaming and streamGeneration.
Queued turn began streaming: points activeAssistantIndex at the last turn, resets speak cursor/text/chunker/barge-in baselines, sets .speaking and starts streaming observation.
units.entry: Observation change delivery (ObservationLoop onChange set up by wireQueuedTurnObserver)

branches.effect: -1 logged when there are no turns

units.does: Cancels prior observers, bumps the speak generation, and registers two ObservationLoops: one (initial delivery) on (turns, speakableTextCursor) feeding speakUpToCursor, one on the stream edge calling finishResponseFromAssistant when VoiceTurnPolicy.spokenResponseFinished and state is .speaking.

branches.effect: true: speakUpToCursor; false: stale callback ignored

units.does: Takes the active assistant turn's text up to the published speakable cursor (Characters), feeds the unspoken delta to the chunker and speaks any completed sentence; updates spokenCharCursor and currentResponseText.
units.entry: Observation change delivery (ObservationLoop onChange from observeAssistantStreaming)

branches.effect: 0 when no cursor published yet (nothing marked safe)
false: return (no new safe text, incl. rewinds)

units.does: Speaks the chunker remainder, speaks a recovery line if the stream errored with nothing spoken, bumps the generation, cancels observers, clears the active index/cursor, and if still .speaking with the synthesizer idle and no LLM task calls finishResponseSpeech to re-arm listening.
units.entry: Observation change delivery (the 'finishing' ObservationLoop set up by observeAssistantStreaming). The VoiceConversationController.finishResponseFromAssistant wrapper (VoiceConversationController.swift:153) has no callers in the repo.

branches.effect: true: finishResponseSpeech (re-arm); false: synthesizer didFinish re-arms later

units.does: If the view model has an errorMessage, nothing was spoken and the synthesizer is idle, speaks a scripted 'Couldn't reach the AI. Try again.' in the app-language voice and clears errorMessage.

branches.cond: errorMessage set, no response text, synthesizer idle
branches.effect: false: return; true: speak recovery line and clear error

flags.text: Clears assistantViewModel.errorMessage after speaking a generic line, so the real error text (e.g. auth/quota) disappears from the chat banner and the user only hears 'Couldn't reach the AI'.

units.does: Speaks a complete non-streamed assistant turn: cancels any LLM task, resets transcript/cursor/chunker/barge-in baselines, sets currentResponseText to the text, rotates recognition, re-arms the timer, sets .speaking and speaks the whole text.
Cancels and nils controller.llmTask.
